explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 64 named tracks and releases across Juno's September 7–13 techno field, SK Eleven's current Confusion album, XX Lab's current François X release, and adjacent/reissue catalogue windows. Written catalogue metadata and attributed release or exact-track descriptions only; no audio audition.
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Confusion's In Cycles, released September 11, supplied exact-title restless-techno propositions, with In Cycles and Space individually described. https://www.juno.co.uk/products/confusion-in-cycles-vinyl/1174157-01/

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: François X's Bound States on XX Lab supplied four hypnotic-techno identity questions rooted in Black American dance music and shaped through European club culture. https://www.kma60.com/

OVERLOOKED / CATALOGUE WINDOW: Juno and Clone back-catalogue/reissue lanes were inspected across Dubwax, Blueprint Archives, Repetitive Rhythm Research and early-tech-house returns; previously ranked, unresolved, rejected, PARKED or utility-retained identities were excluded rather than recycled. https://www.juno.co.uk/techno/this-week/
exclusions: Runs 206–210 source fields, every prior ranked lead or alternate found in current state, canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits and existing global utility identities were excluded.

The five-completed-exploration repetition check avoided every selected boundary from Runs 206–209 and every proposed boundary from zero-resolution Run 210. Placements remain candidate-specific hypotheses, not a boundary-distribution quota.
Previously resolved or unresolved current-week material including Los Totes Vol. 3, Sinee Remixes, End Of Perception, Active Systems, COW, Arovane, G.rush, PS11 and Moving Pressure was not recycled.

Nine leads survived because each has an exact title, concrete current-release context, a constitution-relevant belonging hypothesis and a lawful placement question. Lower-ranked co-release tracks preserve their individual-direction uncertainty; no slot was padded.

The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both listener-protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
